column1: # 《日家奇門》 (鮮紅草, 1998), the column 吉凶時: the twelve hours of a day from
# 子, each with the god it treads and what the table flags it with — 贵人,
# 截空, 五不遇. One row a day and not one a block: the table prints the column
# once for the two halves of the year. Kept are the days whose twelve hours
# come back whole from the text layer, in the order 子 to 亥, and nothing here
# was chosen for agreeing with the engine. The table's own simplified
# characters; its 黄道 and 黑道 are left out, being the god's valence said again.
